Driver 突變頻率：JAK2 V617F 最多，其次 CALR，再來 MPL；三者皆無為 triple-negative，預後較差。
臨床：周邊血 leukoerythroblastosis 與 teardrop cells、脾腫大、骨髓 dry tap；以 DIPSS/MIPSS70 評估預後，JAK inhibitor 緩解症狀，allo-HSCT 為唯一治癒方式。
exam.pitfall_zh: 纖維化非 PMF 專屬：post-PV/post-ET myelofibrosis 需病史區分，MDS with fibrosis 巨核細胞小而低分葉，另有 hairy cell leukemia、骨髓轉移癌與 CML 也可有 reticulin 增加。

quiz.q: 此切片使用何種染色？依 EUMNET 分級大約屬幾級纖維化？

4164.recognize_zh: 兩個子細胞各含一團緻密、分離的染色質，細胞質仍以狹窄橋樑相連、呈啞鈴形，是正在分裂末期（telophase）的細胞出現在周邊血液抹片中。
features: Dumbbell-shaped dividing cell with two daughter halves joined by a narrowing cytoplasmic bridge
Each half contains a dense, clumped chromatin mass without nuclear membrane or nucleolus
Moderate amount of basophilic blue cytoplasm
Nearby mononuclear cell with indented nucleus and blue cytoplasm (reactive lymphocyte or monocyte)
Background red cells with central pallor and scattered platelets; color cast of the photograph limits color assessment
4164.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cell in late mitosis (telophase), with two daughter cells each containing a condensed chromatin mass, separated by a narrowing cytoplasmic bridge with basophilic cytoplasm. A mononuclear cell with an indented nucleus and moderate blue cytoplasm is also present, while the red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. Mitotic figures are rarely seen in normal blood and may occur in reactive states with circulating immunoblasts, in marrow stress, or in leukemic and lymphoma circulation. Findings demonstrate a circulating telophase cell; the lineage cannot be determined morphologically and correlation with the full smear and CBC is advised.

ddx.dx: Binucleated cell (e.g., reactive lymphocyte or dyserythropoietic normoblast)
ddx.vs: Binucleate cells have two nuclei with intact nuclear membranes within one continuous cell rather than condensed chromosome masses at opposite poles.
Overlapping cells show separate complete cell borders, whereas telophase shows a single constricted cytoplasmic bridge.

ddx.dx: Circulating blasts or lymphoma cells in mitosis
ddx.vs: Neoplastic circulation would show additional blasts or atypical cells in the smear, which requires review beyond this field and flow cytometry.

3908.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的分葉核嗜中性球胞質裡布滿粗大、深紫色的顆粒，比正常嗜中性球的淡粉紅細顆粒明顯得多，這就是毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）；旁邊還有胞質淡藍、貼著紅血球邊緣的反應性淋巴球。
features: Segmented/band neutrophils with coarse, dark purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules (toxic granulation, arrow)
Granules distributed throughout the cytoplasm; no discrete Döhle bodies clearly seen in this field
Several large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm indenting adjacent red cells
Red cells largely normochromic with occasional small refractile artifacts
3908.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with coarse, dark purple-staining cytoplasmic granules consistent with toxic granulation (arrow), without a discrete cytoplasmic vacuole or definite Döhle body in this field. Several large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale-blue cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells are also present. Red cells show no significant diagnostic abnormality apart from drying artifact. Findings are consistent with toxic neutrophil changes, suggestive of an infectious/inflammatory process or G-CSF effect.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large, dark and present in all granulocytes (and often lymphocytes and monocytes) of a clinically well patient with mucopolysaccharidosis, not only in neutrophils during infection.
Chédiak-Higashi shows few giant, irregular, fused granules rather than numerous small coarse granules.
Overstaining darkens granules uniformly across the whole smear including red cells, whereas true toxic granulation varies between neutrophils and often accompanies left shift and Döhle bodies.

exam.answer_en: Toxic granulation — neutrophils with coarse dark purple cytoplasmic granules, with reactive lymphocytes; infection/inflammation or G-CSF effect
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指顆粒粗大深紫的嗜中性球，要答 toxic granulation，並列出同屬「toxic changes」的 Döhle body 與 cytoplasmic vacuolation。
機轉：成熟加速使 primary（azurophilic）顆粒保留嗜染性；空泡化對細菌血症／敗血症較具特異性。
非感染原因：G-CSF 治療、懷孕、燒燙傷、發炎性疾病；病人正在用 G-CSF 時不能據此判斷感染。
遺傳性相似者：Alder-Reilly anomaly（mucopolysaccharidosis，所有白血球皆有粗顆粒）、Chédiak-Higashi（LYST，巨大融合顆粒、白化症、免疫缺陷）。
May-Hegglin anomaly 等 MYH9-related disorder 有 Döhle-like 包涵體合併巨大血小板與血小板低下，是與 toxic change 的經典對照。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把抹片過度染色（偏鹼性染液）造成的顆粒變深當 toxic granulation；比較同片其他細胞與背景染色，並確認只在嗜中性球出現。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指嗜中性球內粗大深紫色顆粒叫什麼？除感染外，哪一種常用藥物也會造成相同變化？

3780.recognize_zh: 兩顆大小約紅血球兩倍的細胞，細胞核分成 3–4 葉、以細絲相連，染色質濃密成塊，細胞質淡粉紅色並有細小淡紫色顆粒，是正常成熟的分葉核嗜中性球（segmented neutrophil）。
features: Cell diameter about 2 times an RBC (approximately 12–15 µm)
Nucleus segmented into 3–4 lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments
Coarsely clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Abundant pale pink cytoplasm with fine, evenly distributed lilac (secondary) granules
No toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuoles
Background normocytic, normochromic RBCs and a few platelets
3780.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils. Each has a nucleus divided into three to four lobes connected by thin filaments, with coarse condensed chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale pink with fine lilac specific granules, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuolization. Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets are present. Findings represent normal mature neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have 6 or more lobes (or >5% with 5 lobes), whereas these cells have 3–4 lobes.
A band has a continuous, non-segmented curved nucleus without thin filamentous constrictions.
Eosinophils are usually bilobed with large, refractile orange-red granules instead of fine lilac granules.

exam.answer_en: Normal mature segmented neutrophils — 3–4 nuclear lobes joined by thin filaments, clumped chromatin, fine lilac specific granules
pearls_zh: 考法：正常細胞題，考官會問「幾葉、有沒有毒性變化、是不是 hypersegmented」；3–4 葉、無毒性顆粒/Döhle body/空泡 = 正常成熟嗜中性球。
Hypersegmentation 定義：出現 ≥1 顆 6 葉，或 5 葉嗜中性球 >5%；最常見於 B12/folate 缺乏的 megaloblastic anemia，也見於 hydroxyurea 等藥物。
Band vs segmented：band 核為連續 U/S 形、無細絲狀收縮，分葉之間以細絲相連才算 segmented。
嗜中性球低下定義 ANC <1.5×10^9/L；Duffy-null 相關的 benign ethnic neutropenia 無感染風險增加，不需過度檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把正常 4 葉細胞誤判為 hypersegmented；hypersegmentation 需 ≥6 葉或 5 葉細胞 >5%，單看一兩顆 4 葉細胞沒有意義。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球要至少有幾葉才算 hypersegmented？最常見的原因是什麼？
quiz.a: ≥6 葉（或 5 葉 >5%）；維生素 B12/葉酸缺乏

3588.recognize_zh: 淋巴球體積大，細胞質豐富、淡藍色，周邊顏色較深，邊緣被旁邊紅血球壓出凹痕；核卵圓、染色質略疏鬆，細胞質角落有少數小空泡。這是反應性（非典型）淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte, about 2 times RBC diameter, with low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Oval nucleus with moderately condensed, slightly open chromatin; no prominent nucleolus
Abundant pale-blue cytoplasm with deeper basophilia at the periphery
Cytoplasmic border indented by adjacent RBCs
A few small vacuoles at one pole of the cytoplasm
Adjacent normal platelets; RBCs normochromic
3588.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with an oval nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin, and abundant pale-blue cytoplasm. The cytoplasm shows peripheral basophilia, is indented by neighboring red cells, and contains a few small vacuoles. No nucleoli or cytoplasmic granules are seen. Findings are consistent with a reactive (atypical) lymphocyte, as in infectious mononucleosis or other viral infections.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm with a high N:C ratio.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections and a spongy chromatin pattern and are BRAF V600E+/CD103+/CD25+/CD11c+.
Monocytes have folded nuclei and grey ground-glass cytoplasm without peripheral basophilia.
Lymphoma cells are monotonous and show nuclear irregularity, nucleoli, and clonal immunophenotype, unlike this heterogeneous reactive cell.

exam.answer_en: Reactive (atypical) lymphocyte — large lymphocyte with abundant cytoplasm showing peripheral basophilia indented by adjacent RBCs
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆大細胞，問「反應性還是腫瘤性」；答出細胞質周邊嗜鹼性、被紅血球壓凹（scalloping），支持反應性淋巴球。
傳染性單核球增多症常見三聯：發燒、咽喉炎、頸部淋巴結腫大，加上淋巴球增多與 >10% 反應性淋巴球；可伴肝脾腫大。
EBV 感染者若使用 ampicillin／amoxicillin 常出現皮疹；脾腫大者應避免接觸性運動以防脾破裂。
若反應性淋巴球族群形態單調或持續不退，需送 flow cytometry 排除淋巴增生性腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 hairy cell 或大細胞淋巴瘤細胞混淆；hairy cell 有細毛狀細胞質突起且核染色質均勻，淋巴瘤細胞有明顯核仁與形態單調，反應性淋巴球則形態多樣、細胞質包繞紅血球。

quiz.q: 這顆細胞質邊緣被紅血球壓出凹痕、周邊顏色較深的大淋巴球，最可能見於哪種臨床情境？
quiz.a: 反應性淋巴球，典型見於 EBV 傳染性單核球增多症（或其他病毒感染）。

3652.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球各階段成熟、紅血球母細胞散在，同時有不少小而圓、染色質濃密、細胞質極少的淋巴球／造血原細胞（hematogones），這種淋巴球比例偏高的組合符合兒童正常骨髓。
features: Cellular aspirate with trilineage hematopoiesis and orderly granulocytic maturation
Relatively numerous small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm (lymphocytes/hematogones)
Erythroid precursors at various stages with round nuclei and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Occasional larger cells with deep blue cytoplasm consistent with proerythroblasts/early precursors, not forming sheets
No clusters of atypical blasts or dysplastic forms
3652.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows trilineage hematopoiesis with orderly granulocytic and erythroid maturation. Small lymphoid cells, including lymphocytes and likely hematogones with scant cytoplasm and condensed homogeneous chromatin, are relatively prominent, as is expected in young children. Scattered early precursors are present without a sheet-like increase in blasts or dysplasia. Findings are consistent with a normal pediatric bone marrow aspirate.

ddx.vs: Shows sheets of monotonous lymphoblasts with finer chromatin and replacement of normal hematopoiesis, and flow cytometry shows an aberrant immunophenotype rather than the orderly maturation pattern of hematogones.
A quantitative increase of the same benign precursors, usually after chemotherapy or in cytopenias, distinguished from normal only by count and clinical context.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Forms cohesive clumps or rosettes of tumor cells with neuropil, rather than dispersed lymphoid cells mixed with normal hematopoiesis.

3524.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的數個紅血球內含成簇的不規則藍紫色小顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），其中一顆細胞質淡且顆粒散布較廣；背景其他紅血球只偶見單一小點，含鐵顆粒的紅血球即鐵粒紅血球（siderocytes）。
features: Several RBCs containing clusters of small irregular basophilic granules (arrows)
One pale red cell with more widely dispersed granules throughout the cytoplasm
Granule clusters located centrally or peripherally within affected cells
Occasional tiny single dots in other red cells
Mild anisocytosis; scattered platelets
3524.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisocytosis with scattered red cells containing clusters of small, irregular, basophilic granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies (arrows); one pale erythrocyte shows more widely distributed granules. Occasional tiny dots are present in other red cells. These inclusion-bearing cells represent siderocytes, and an iron stain would confirm the ferritin/iron nature of the granules. Findings are consistent with siderocytes, as seen in hyposplenism, sideroblastic anemia, and disorders of ineffective erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Stippling granules are uniformly distributed throughout the cell and do not stain with Prussian blue.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single larger round dense inclusions rather than clusters of fine irregular granules.
Overlying platelets have a pale blue cytoplasmic halo around granules, whereas Pappenheimer bodies lie within the RBC without a halo.

exam.answer_en: Siderocytes — erythrocytes containing clusters of irregular Pappenheimer bodies (iron-containing granules)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含顆粒紅血球問「這是什麼包涵體？如何證明含鐵？」，應答 Pappenheimer bodies、Prussian blue 陽性。
成分：含鐵的 ferritin/hemosiderin 聚集，正常由脾臟 pitting 移除，所以脾切除後明顯增加。
Siderocyte（周邊血紅血球）與 ring sideroblast（骨髓有核紅血球、鐵顆粒環核）要分清；後者是 sideroblastic anemia 與 SF3B1 突變 MDS 的診斷重點。
若同一抹片還有 Howell-Jolly bodies 與 target cells，應聯想脾切除或功能性無脾。
exam.pitfall_zh: 疊在紅血球上的血小板易被誤認：血小板顆粒外有淡藍色 hyalomere、常越出紅血球邊界；Pappenheimer bodies 位於紅血球內且無外圍暈。

quiz.q: 周邊血中含鐵顆粒的紅血球稱為什麼？骨髓中鐵顆粒環繞核周的有核紅血球又稱為什麼？

3140.recognize_zh: 一群大小一致的中型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，只有極少量淡藍色胞質且無顆粒，符合前驅B淋巴母細胞白血病（B-ALL）的形態。
features: Uniform medium-to-large blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed, evenly stippled chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic blebs or tails
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules seen
3140.describe_en: The smear shows a cluster of monotonous medium-to-large blasts with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Nuclei are round to oval with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and the scant cytoplasm is pale blue and agranular, occasionally forming small blebs. No Auer rods or granules are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; B-lineage assignment requires flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD22, cytoplasmic CD79a, TdT).

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and are separated by flow cytometry showing cytoplasmic CD3 and lack of B-lineage markers.
Minimally differentiated myeloblasts may look identical but express MPO (by flow), CD13, CD33, and CD117 rather than B-cell antigens.
Hematogones show a maturation spectrum with more condensed chromatin and a continuous CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern rather than a uniform aberrant population.
Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative, CD5-positive, and cyclin D1-positive, usually in adults.

exam.answer_en: B-lymphoblastic leukemia — monotonous agranular blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli; lineage by flow
pearls_zh: 考法：指著這群無顆粒、核仁不明顯的母細胞，問 lymphoblast 還是 myeloblast；形態只能說「lymphoblast-like」，分系一定要 flow。
B-ALL 表型：CD19+、cCD79a+、CD22+、TdT+、CD34±、CD10±；MPO 陰性。cytochemistry 可見 PAS 塊狀（block）陽性。
必考基因：兒童 hyperdiploidy 與 ETV6::RUNX1 t(12;21) 預後佳；BCR::ABL1 t(9;22) 需加 TKI；KMT2A 重組（嬰兒、CD10−）預後差；hypodiploidy 預後差。
BCR::ABL1-like（Ph-like）B-ALL 在 WHO 5th 與 ICC 皆列為獨立亞型，常見於青少年與年輕成人，預後差。
誘導治療前注意 tumor lysis syndrome；誘導結束 MRD 是最強的預後因子之一。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 AML with minimal differentiation 或 hematogones 混淆；AML-M0 表現 CD13/CD33/CD117，hematogones 在 flow 呈連續成熟光譜、非單一異常族群。

quiz.q: 圖中這群無顆粒、核質比極高的母細胞，要確認 B 系需要做哪項檢查？列出三個關鍵標記。

3012.recognize_zh: 真皮內片狀的大型多形性細胞，核大、腎形或不規則並有核仁，細胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，其間散在小淋巴球、嗜酸性球與管壁增厚的小血管，符合 CD30+ 的原發性皮膚退行性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate dominated by large pleomorphic cells in sheets
Large irregular, oval to reniform vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes, eosinophils, and neutrophils
Thick-walled small vessels and collagen bundles within the infiltrate
3012.describe_en: Section of dermis shows a dense, sheet-like infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and irregular, oval to reniform vesicular nuclei containing distinct nucleoli. Scattered small lymphocytes, eosinophils, and neutrophils are admixed, and thick-walled small vessels and collagen bundles course through the infiltrate. The epidermis is not included in this field. Findings are consistent with a large cell lymphoma of the skin and, with diffuse CD30 expression, ALK negativity, and absence of systemic disease, with primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Histology may be identical; LyP presents as crops of regressing small papules, whereas pcALCL is a solitary or localized nodule over 2 cm that persists.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: DLBCL-LT is CD20/PAX5-positive with BCL2/MUM1 expression and lacks the strong uniform CD30 of ALCL.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous Hodgkin-like or reactive CD30+ infiltrates (e.g., arthropod bite, viral)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates have scattered rather than sheet-like CD30+ cells within a mixed wedge-shaped infiltrate, without cohesive clusters of large atypical cells.

2628.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色（Prussian blue，紅色核對比染色）高倍下，數顆紅血球前驅細胞的細胞質內有藍綠色鐵顆粒聚集在核周圍、部分環繞細胞核，提示環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）。
features: Iron-stained aspirate with red nuclear counterstain; siderotic granules appear blue-green
Several erythroid precursors with coarse blue granules clustered in a perinuclear distribution, partially encircling the nucleus
Granules are more numerous and coarser than in normal sideroblasts
Large immature cells with fine chromatin and no iron granules (early precursors or blasts)
Scattered extracellular iron granules in the background
2628.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue and a red nuclear counterstain shows several erythroid precursors containing coarse, blue-green siderotic granules arranged around the nucleus, in some cells covering a substantial portion of the nuclear circumference, consistent with ring sideroblasts. Large immature nucleated cells lacking iron granules and occasional extracellular iron granules are also present. A formal count of ring sideroblasts as a percentage of erythroid precursors is required, as is correlation with the Romanowsky-stained smear for dysplasia and blast percentage. Findings are consistent with a sideroblastic process, supporting myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts in the stated context.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only one to a few small, randomly scattered granules, not coarse granules encircling at least one-third of the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Alcohol-, drug- (isoniazid, linezolid) or copper deficiency-related sideroblastic anemia
ddx.vs: These show identical ring sideroblasts, so exposure history, copper and zinc levels, and lack of SF3B1 mutation or clonal cytogenetics are required to separate them.
Storage iron lies in macrophage cytoplasm or extracellular fragments rather than as perinuclear granules within erythroid precursors.

exam.answer_en: Ring sideroblasts on Prussian blue iron stain — perinuclear siderotic granules in erythroid precursors, supporting MDS with ring sideroblasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核周圍一圈藍色顆粒的紅母細胞，問名稱與定義；ICSH 定義為 ≥ 5 顆鐵顆粒、環繞至少 1/3 核周。
鐵沉積於紅母細胞的 mitochondria（heme 合成障礙），因此呈核周分布；巨噬細胞內或細胞外鐵是 storage iron，不算。
WHO 5th：MDS with low blasts and SF3B1 mutation；若 SF3B1 未驗或野生型，ring sideroblasts ≥ 15% 可替代。ICC 2022 則要求 SF3B1 突變（VAF ≥ 10%）。
治療關聯：低風險 MDS-RS 貧血、ESA 失效者，luspatercept 為重要選項（MEDALIST 試驗）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與正常 sideroblast 混淆：正常者僅少數細小、隨機散布的顆粒，不形成核周環；另需排除酒精、isoniazid、linezolid、銅缺乏等次發原因。

quiz.q: 圖中核周有藍色鐵顆粒的細胞稱為什麼？ICSH 的形態定義為何？
quiz.a: Ring sideroblast；≥ 5 顆 siderotic granules 環繞 ≥ 1/3 核周

2500.recognize_zh: 抹片中一群大型組織球樣細胞，胞質豐富淡染、邊緣有小泡突起，細胞核呈卵圓形並有摺痕與核溝（nuclear grooves），右側旁邊有嗜伊紅性白血球，這種組合是蘭格罕細胞組織球增生症的典型細胞學表現。
features: Cohesive cluster of large mononuclear cells with abundant pale lilac cytoplasm and blebbed borders
Oval to reniform nuclei with nuclear folds and longitudinal grooves
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; low N:C ratio
Adjacent eosinophil with orange-red granules at right
Background small lymphocytes
2500.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained cytologic preparation shows a loose cluster of large histiocytoid cells with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and blebbed cytoplasmic borders. The nuclei are oval to kidney-shaped with delicate chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and characteristic nuclear folds and grooves. An eosinophil and scattered small lymphocytes are present nearby. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation with CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have round eccentric nuclei without grooves and often contain phagocytosed debris or vacuoles, and are CD1a negative.
Rosai-Dorfman cells are larger with round vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes.
Carcinoma clusters show nuclear atypia, prominent nucleoli and tight cohesion without grooved nuclei or accompanying eosinophils.

exam.answer_en: Langerhans cell histiocytosis — histiocytoid cells with grooved/folded (coffee-bean) nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm, with eosinophils
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有核溝與摺痕的大細胞，並指旁邊的嗜伊紅性白血球，問診斷；「核溝細胞 + eosinophils」是 LCH 的經典組合。
確診 IHC：CD1a+、langerin（CD207）+、S100+；cyclin D1 通常亦陽性。
分子：BRAF V600E 約半數以上，可用 VE1 IHC 或分子檢測；BRAF 野生型常見 MAP2K1 突變。
臨床：兒童多見，常侵犯骨（顱骨溶骨病灶）、皮膚、垂體（diabetes insipidus）；肝、脾、骨髓為 risk organs。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性巨噬細胞或 Rosai-Dorfman：巨噬細胞核圓無核溝、常含吞噬物；Rosai-Dorfman 細胞核圓空泡狀、核仁明顯並有 emperipolesis，S100+ 但 CD1a−。

quiz.q: 圖中帶核溝的組織球樣細胞伴隨嗜伊紅性白血球，確診需哪些免疫染色？
quiz.a: CD1a、langerin（CD207）、S100 陽性 → Langerhans cell histiocytosis

2180.recognize_zh: 低倍小腸黏膜：絨毛仍呈指狀但略短，固有層有淋巴漿細胞浸潤，黏膜下層可見脂肪與腺體；本視野未見腫瘤形成或透壁浸潤，只能作為背景黏膜參考，無法單獨診斷 EATL。
features: Small-intestinal mucosa with finger-like villi of mildly variable height
Lamina propria with moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate
Crypts of normal-appearing density with goblet cells
Submucosa with adipose tissue and glandular structures at top of field
No mass-forming atypical lymphoid infiltrate or ulceration in this field
2180.describe_en: Low-power section of small intestine shows mucosa with finger-like villi of mildly variable height, crypts with goblet cells, and a moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the lamina propria. Submucosal adipose tissue and glands are present at the top of the field. No ulceration, mass lesion or transmural atypical lymphoid infiltrate is identified, and intraepithelial lymphocytes cannot be assessed at this magnification. The image is not diagnostic of enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma on its own and likely represents non-tumoral mucosa; correlation with the tumor sections and CD3/CD8 immunostains is needed.

ddx.dx: Normal or mildly inflamed small-bowel mucosa
ddx.vs: Preserved villous architecture without increased intraepithelial lymphocytes favors normal mucosa, requiring higher power and CD3 counts to confirm.
Celiac disease shows villous blunting to flattening with crypt hyperplasia and increased intraepithelial lymphocytes, which are not convincingly seen here.
MEITL shows sheets of monomorphic medium-sized CD8+ CD56+ cells with marked epitheliotropism, absent in this field.

2116.recognize_zh: 一群大型細胞成簇排列，核圓偏位於細胞一端，胞質豐富淡藍呈泡沫狀，並可見與核分開的淡染區（遠離核的 hof），外觀像大型漿細胞但核染色質較細緻，這就是骨髓中的造骨細胞（osteoblast）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells, larger than plasma cells
Round to oval eccentric nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale to medium blue, slightly foamy cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Pale perinuclear clearing (Golgi zone) located away from the nucleus
Background of normal hematopoietic cells, including a neutrophil, lymphocytes, and platelets
2116.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large cells with round eccentric nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and abundant pale blue foamy cytoplasm with a pale clear zone separated from the nucleus. The cells are larger than plasma cells and lack the clock-face chromatin of plasma cells. Background hematopoietic elements are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with osteoblasts, a normal marrow constituent more frequently seen in aspirates from children or areas of active bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof immediately adjacent to the nucleus, whereas the osteoblast Golgi zone lies away from the nucleus.
Carcinoma clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, and molding, and are cytokeratin positive, unlike the bland uniform osteoblasts.
Osteoclasts are multinucleated giant cells with many separate nuclei, whereas each osteoblast has a single nucleus.
Mast cells contain dense purple metachromatic granules obscuring the nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Osteoblasts in bone marrow aspirate — cohesive cluster of large cells with eccentric nuclei and a pale Golgi zone separate from the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指成群的大細胞，問「是漿細胞、腫瘤細胞還是正常成分？」答 osteoblasts，屬正常骨髓成分。
辨識點：比漿細胞大、呈 comet/蝌蚪狀，淡染 Golgi 區離核有一段距離；漿細胞 hof 緊貼核旁。
常見情境：兒童骨髓、骨折癒合、hyperparathyroidism、Paget disease、轉移癌周邊等骨重塑活躍時；osteoblast 富含 alkaline phosphatase。
對照 osteoclast：多核巨細胞，核彼此分離、形態一致；megakaryocyte 則為單一多葉核。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為漿細胞（骨髓瘤）或轉移癌：漿細胞較小、有車輪狀染色質與緊貼核的 hof；轉移癌核多形、核仁大、有核重疊塑形且 keratin 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中成群、核偏位且淡染區遠離核的大細胞是什麼？與漿細胞 hof 位置有何差異？
quiz.a: Osteoblasts；osteoblast 淡染區離核，漿細胞 hof 緊貼核旁

1988.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結：箭頭指出被膜下竇與中間竇被一片片淡粉紅色的大型細胞填滿，與周圍深藍色的殘存淋巴組織形成鮮明對比；這種竇內（sinusoidal）生長方式是 anaplastic 型 DLBCL 的特徵，也很像 ALCL 或轉移癌。
features: Lymph node with thin capsule and residual dark blue lymphoid parenchyma
Pale eosinophilic sheets of large cells distending subcapsular and intermediate sinuses (arrows)
Cohesive-appearing sinusoidal aggregates mimicking metastatic carcinoma
Sharp demarcation between tumor-filled sinuses and small lymphocytes
Individual cytologic detail not resolved at this magnification
1988.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows partial involvement by pale sheets of large cells that distend the subcapsular and intermediate sinuses (arrows), sharply demarcated from the residual small lymphocyte-rich parenchyma. The sinusoidal, cohesive-appearing growth pattern mimics metastatic carcinoma. Cytologic detail is not assessable at this magnification. In the context of a B-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant; immunohistochemistry (CD20, PAX5, CD30, ALK, keratin) is required to exclude ALCL and carcinoma.

ddx.dx: ALK-positive or ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: ALCL shares sinusoidal growth and CD30 expression but is a T-cell neoplasm lacking CD20/PAX5, with hallmark cells and ALK or aberrant T-cell markers.
Carcinoma in sinuses is keratin positive and CD45/CD20 negative, whereas lymphoma cells are CD45 and B-cell marker positive.
Melanoma may show pigment and is S100/SOX10 and melan-A positive and CD45 negative.
Sinus histiocytes are bland with abundant pink cytoplasm and small oval nuclei, CD68/CD163 positive, without cytologic atypia or mitoses.

1796.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中沿著骨小樑表面排成一整列、細胞核偏向一側、細胞質嗜鹼性的豐滿梭形至立方細胞（箭頭），緊貼類骨質邊緣，是造骨細胞（osteoblast）襯覆骨表面的典型表現。
features: Single row of plump cuboidal to spindled cells lining the surface of a bony trabecula (arrows)
Oval, eccentrically placed nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Amphophilic to basophilic cytoplasm oriented toward the bone surface
Adjacent lamellar bone with osteocytes in lacunae
Separated marrow space below with a small cluster of hematopoietic cells and red cells
1796.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula with osteocytes in lacunae. Its surface is lined by a continuous row of plump cuboidal to spindled cells with eccentric oval nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm (arrows), consistent with active osteoblasts. The adjacent marrow space contains a small focus of hematopoietic cells without atypia. Findings are consistent with osteoblastic rimming of bone, a normal feature of bone formation and remodeling.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows cohesive atypical cells with pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei invading the marrow rather than a single orderly row of bland cells on the bone surface.

ddx.dx: Endothelial cells or bone lining cells
ddx.vs: Inactive lining cells and endothelium are flat and attenuated with thin nuclei, unlike plump cuboidal osteoblasts with abundant cytoplasm.
Osteoclasts are large multinucleated cells sitting in resorption (Howship) lacunae rather than mononuclear cells in a row.

1732.recognize_zh: 抹片中一群大型圓形細胞，細胞質充滿密集、深紫色的嗜鹼性（metachromatic）顆粒並部分遮蓋圓形至卵圓形細胞核，周圍還散落脫出的顆粒，這種成群出現的肥大細胞符合肥大細胞白血病（mast cell leukemia）。
features: Sheet of large round to oval cells packed together, several times the size of red cells
Cytoplasm filled with dense, coarse dark purple metachromatic granules that partly obscure the nucleus
Round to oval centrally placed nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli not discernible
Numerous extruded granules scattered in the background between cells
Some cells show paler, less granular zones, suggesting partial hypogranularity; image resolution limits fine detail
1732.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained smear shows a cohesive-appearing sheet of large round cells with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse dark purple metachromatic granules, round to oval central nuclei, and numerous extruded granules in the background. Some cells show areas of relative hypogranularity. The specimen source and the proportion of mast cells cannot be determined from this image. Findings are consistent with a marked increase in mast cells; in the appropriate setting, mast cells forming at least 20% of nucleated cells on the aspirate smear support mast cell leukemia, with confirmation by tryptase, CD117, CD25, and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.dx: Basophils (e.g., basophilia in CML or acute basophilic leukemia)
ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with segmented or lobulated nuclei and water-soluble granules that overlie the nucleus, whereas mast cells are larger with round central nuclei and are strongly CD117 and tryptase positive.
Reactive mast cells are scattered singly, spindled or round, without sheets, and lack CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple granules, bilobed nuclei, and Auer rod bundles, and are MPO strongly positive rather than tryptase positive.
These show a blast population with admixed immature mast cells and lack the dominant mature-appearing granular mast cell sheets; flow and KIT mutation testing help separate them.

1668.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現四顆漿細胞樣細胞：核圓且偏向一側、染色質塊狀，細胞質深藍，部分可見核旁淡染區（hof）；周邊血中看到成群漿細胞，是漿細胞白血病的線索。
features: Four circulating plasmacytoid cells in a single field
Eccentrically placed round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin
Moderate to abundant deep-blue cytoplasm
Perinuclear clearing (hof) visible in some cells
Background red cells without marked rouleaux in this thin area
1668.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and moderately abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with a perinuclear hof. The cells are relatively mature-appearing and uniform. Numerous circulating plasma cells of this type are consistent with plasma cell leukemia (5% or more circulating plasma cells by current criteria); confirmation of a clonal CD138+/CD38+ population with light-chain restriction by flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (e.g., viral infection, serum sickness)
ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, accompanied by reactive lymphocytes, and polytypic on flow cytometry.
Shows a spectrum dominated by small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with a CD19+/CD20+ clonal B-cell population.
Reactive lymphocytes have more central nuclei, less clumped chromatin and lack a well-formed hof.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell leukemia — multiple circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, deep-blue cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs in PB
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「周邊血這些細胞是什麼？數量代表什麼？」答漿細胞；周邊血漿細胞 ≥5%（IMWG 2021 定義）即為 plasma cell leukemia。
分為 primary PCL（初診即白血病表現）與 secondary PCL（由既有 myeloma 進展）；兩者皆為侵襲性、預後差。
流式：CD38+/CD138+、CD19−、cytoplasmic κ 或 λ 輕鏈限制；PCL 常 CD56 陰性（與骨髓外擴散相關）。
遺傳：primary PCL 常見 t(11;14)，並常有 del(17p)、1q gain 等高風險異常，需 FISH 評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性漿細胞樣淋巴球（如病毒感染）；反應性者核較居中、染色質較不塊狀、無明確核周亮區，且伴其他反應性淋巴球、κ/λ 多株。

quiz.q: 周邊血見圖中細胞，依 IMWG 2021 定義，漿細胞比例需達多少才能診斷 plasma cell leukemia？
quiz.a: 周邊血白血球中漿細胞 ≥5%。

63364.recognize_zh: 中央一顆淋巴球的細胞質比一般小淋巴球多，且在右側細胞質中可見少數粗大的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），這是大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte）的特徵。
features: Single lymphocyte roughly 1.3-1.5 times the diameter of a red cell
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, eccentrically distributed toward the right
A few coarse, discrete azurophilic (red-purple) cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells include many oval forms (mild ovalocytosis); rare platelets
63364.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with a notable proportion of oval forms and a single lymphocyte in the center of the field. The lymphocyte is slightly larger than a small resting lymphocyte, with a round nucleus with mature clumped chromatin and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm containing a few coarse azurophilic granules. No nucleoli, cytoplasmic basophilia or blast features are seen. Findings are consistent with a large granular (cytotoxic T or NK) lymphocyte; a persistent absolute increase would warrant flow cytometry and TCR clonality studies to exclude T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant cytoplasm that shows peripheral basophilia and scalloping around red cells, usually without discrete azurophilic granules.
Monocytes are larger with a folded or kidney-shaped nucleus, lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with very fine, dust-like granules.
Morphology of individual cells is identical; the leukemia requires a sustained LGL count (usually >2 x 10^9/L) with clonal CD3+CD8+CD57+ cells on flow cytometry and TCR rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: Large granular lymphocyte — lymphocyte with increased cytoplasm containing a few coarse azurophilic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆淋巴球問名稱；關鍵在較多淡藍胞質內有少數粗大紫紅嗜天青顆粒，對應 cytotoxic T cell 或 NK cell。
Flow：T-LGL 為 CD3+、CD8+、CD57+、CD16+（常 TCR αβ）；NK-LGL 為 CD3−、CD56+、CD16+。
T-LGL leukemia：持續 LGL 增加、常伴 neutropenia 與 rheumatoid arthritis；約 4 成有 STAT3 mutation，需以 TCR 基因重排證明克隆性。
治療：有症狀（嚴重 neutropenia、輸血依賴貧血）才治療，常用 methotrexate、cyclophosphamide 或 cyclosporine。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 reactive lymphocyte 或 monocyte；reactive lymphocyte 胞質深藍環繞紅血球、少有顆粒，monocyte 核摺疊且胞質灰藍。

quiz.q: 這顆淋巴球稱為什麼？持續增加伴 neutropenia 時要懷疑什麼疾病？

60932.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間散布幾個遠小於紅血球（約其四分之一大小）、無核、帶紫色細顆粒的小點，就是正常大小的血小板（normal platelets）。
features: A few small anucleate platelets, roughly one-quarter to one-third the diameter of a red cell
Platelets show fine purple (alpha) granules with scant pale cytoplasm
Platelets are dispersed singly without clumping
Background normocytic, normochromic red cells with normal central pallor and minimal poikilocytosis
No leukocytes in this low-to-intermediate power field
60932.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with preserved central pallor and no significant poikilocytosis. Scattered small platelets are present singly, each much smaller than a red cell, with fine purple granules and scant pale cytoplasm. No platelet clumps, large or giant platelets, or leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with normal platelet morphology; platelet number should be assessed over multiple fields.

ddx.vs: Large platelets exceed about 4 micrometers, approaching half a red cell diameter, whereas these are clearly small.

ddx.dx: Red cell inclusions (Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer bodies)
ddx.vs: Inclusions lie within the red cell outline, whereas these platelets are separate from red cells in the background.
Precipitate forms irregular dark refractile dots in variable planes, lacking the granular center and pale cytoplasm of platelets.

60292.recognize_zh: 這群細胞核呈圓形、位於中央，細胞質從深藍色（嗜鹼性幼紅血球）逐步變成灰藍色、核也漸濃縮變小（多染性幼紅血球），同一視野呈現紅血球系列的成熟階段（erythroid precursors）。
features: Cluster of round cells with central round nuclei and smooth cell borders
Earlier forms with coarsely granular chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm (basophilic normoblasts)
Smaller later forms with condensed, dark nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm (polychromatophilic normoblasts)
Admixed granulocytic cells, including a granulated myeloid precursor and a segmented neutrophil
Several stripped or smudged nuclei and a marrow particle edge in the background
60292.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of erythroid precursors at different stages of maturation. Basophilic normoblasts have round nuclei with coarsely granular chromatin and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm, while smaller polychromatophilic normoblasts show more condensed nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm. A granulated myeloid precursor, a segmented neutrophil and several smudged nuclei are also present. Maturation appears orderly without megaloblastic change or multinucleation. Findings are consistent with normal maturing erythroid precursors.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have denser, smudgier chromatin and pale sky-blue cytoplasm, unlike the round crisply clumped nuclei and intensely basophilic cytoplasm of erythroid precursors.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof, whereas these cells have centrally placed nuclei without a hof.
Megaloblasts are larger with open sieve-like chromatin that lags behind cytoplasmic hemoglobinization, which is not seen in these orderly maturing cells.

exam.answer_en: Normal maturing erythroid precursors — basophilic and polychromatophilic normoblasts with round central nuclei and orderly maturation
pearls_zh: 考法：考官依序指幾顆幼紅血球，要你排出 proerythroblast → basophilic → polychromatophilic → orthochromatic normoblast → reticulocyte。
成熟規律：細胞變小、核染色質越來越濃縮、細胞質由深藍（RNA 多）轉灰藍再轉粉紅（血紅素累積），orthochromatic 階段核被排出。
IHC 標記：E-cadherin 標記早期幼紅血球；glycophorin A（CD235a）與 hemoglobin 標記較成熟階段；CD71 貫穿多階段。
M:E ratio 正常約 2–4:1；比值下降見於溶血或無效造血，上升見於感染或紅血球系低下（如 PRCA）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為淋巴球或 plasma cell：幼紅血球核圓且位於中央、細胞質無顆粒深藍且邊緣圓滑；plasma cell 核偏心並有核旁 hof，淋巴球細胞質較少。

quiz.q: 請寫出紅血球系前驅細胞由早到晚的成熟順序。
quiz.a: Proerythroblast → basophilic normoblast → polychromatophilic normoblast → orthochromatic normoblast → reticulocyte

132.recognize_zh: 乳房脂肪組織旁有纖維化背景與濃密淋巴漿細胞浸潤，其間散在胞質豐富淡染、核呈泡狀且核仁明顯的大型組織球；高倍下組織球胞質內含完整淋巴球或漿細胞（emperipolesis，箭頭），S-100 強陽性並清楚勾勒出被吞入的細胞輪廓，符合結外 Rosai-Dorfman disease。
features: Large polygonal histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated to foamy eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Round vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small distinct central nucleoli
Emperipolesis: intact lymphocytes, plasma cells and a neutrophil/eosinophil-like cell within histiocyte cytoplasm (arrows)
Strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S-100 staining of histiocytes, with engulfed cells appearing as unstained halos
Dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in a fibrotic/sclerotic stroma extending around a muscular vessel and into adjacent adipose tissue
Numerous plasma cells highlighted by IHC; kappa and lambda ISH show a polytypic plasma cell population
132.describe_en: Core biopsy of breast shows a cellular, partly sclerotic lesion adjacent to mature adipose tissue, composed of sheets of large pale histiocytes admixed with a dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate and extending around a thick-walled vessel. At high power, the histiocytes have abundant pale to foamy cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, and many contain intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within their cytoplasm (emperipolesis). No significant nuclear atypia, mitotic activity, necrosis or cohesive epithelial clusters are seen in these fields. The histiocytes are strongly S-100 positive, outlining the engulfed cells. Plasma cells are abundant, and kappa and lambda in situ hybridization show a polytypic pattern. Findings are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease involving the breast.

ddx.vs: IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis without large S-100-positive emperipolesis-containing histiocytes, although RDD may also contain increased IgG4-positive plasma cells.
LCH cells are smaller with grooved, reniform nuclei, are CD1a and langerin positive, lack emperipolesis and are typically accompanied by eosinophils.
Granular cell tumor is also S-100 positive but has coarse eosinophilic PAS-positive cytoplasmic granules, lacks emperipolesis and lacks the heavy lymphoplasmacytic background.
Carcinoma cells are keratin and GATA3 positive, often show intracytoplasmic lumina and single-file infiltration, and are S-100 negative without emperipolesis.

132.stain: H&E; IHC: S-100, plasma cell IHC; ISH: kappa/lambda
captions: H&E low power: lymphoplasmacytic and histiocytic infiltrate with sclerosis around a muscular vessel, adjacent fat
H&E medium power: dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate admixed with clusters of large pale histiocytes
H&E high power: large histiocyte with vesicular nucleus engulfing intact inflammatory cells (emperipolesis, arrow)
H&E high power: pale histiocyte containing multiple intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis, arrow)
S-100 IHC: strong staining of histiocytes with engulfed cells seen as negative halos (arrows)
S-100 IHC high power: large positive histiocyte containing several unstained lymphocytes (arrow)
IHC for plasma cells (likely IgG/IgG4) at low power: numerous positive plasma cells among histiocytes
Same plasma cell IHC at higher power: strongly positive plasma cells in a background of negative histiocytes
Kappa ISH: numerous positive plasma cells
Lambda ISH: fewer but readily identified positive plasma cells, supporting a polytypic population

exam.answer_en: Extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease of breast — large pale S-100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis in fibrotic lymphoplasmacytic background
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指著組織球胞質內完整的淋巴球或漿細胞，問現象名稱（emperipolesis），並要求加做 S-100 確認。
表型：S-100 陽性（核與胞質）、CD68/CD163 陽性，CD1a 與 langerin 陰性；S-100 染色時被吞入的細胞呈未染色的空暈，最容易辨認。
結外 RDD 纖維化較明顯、emperipolesis 較少，乳房病灶影像上可像癌；部分病例有 KRAS/MAP2K1 突變。
漿細胞多時應看 IgG4/IgG 比例與 kappa/lambda，以排除 IgG4 相關疾病與漿細胞腫瘤；本例為多株性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為脂肪壞死的泡沫組織球或 Langerhans cell histiocytosis；前者 S-100 陰性，後者核有溝、CD1a/langerin 陽性。

quiz.q: 組織球胞質內含完整淋巴球的現象稱為什麼？確認此組織球要做哪個 IHC？

68.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見成片的大型未成熟細胞，核呈卵圓或凹折、染色質細緻、有核仁，取代正常造血；抹片中母細胞（blast）量多，部分細胞質灰藍、核有凹摺，呈單核球樣分化。形態只能判定為急性骨髓性白血病（AML），雙等位 CEBPA 突變需靠分子檢測確認。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of large immature cells effacing normal hematopoiesis (biopsy)
Blasts with oval to folded/indented nuclei, fine open chromatin, and visible nucleoli
Aspirate blasts with moderate basophilic to grey-blue cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hof, a subset with monocytoid nuclear folding
Residual scattered megakaryocytes, including small hypolobated forms, and hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Peripheral blood shows occasional circulating blast and mature neutrophils with small nuclear appendages; background RBCs with crenation
No Auer rods, cup-like nuclei, or abnormal promyelocytes evident in these fields
68.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows occasional circulating blasts with high N:C ratio and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, along with scattered mature neutrophils. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular for age, with interstitial to sheet-like infiltration by large immature mononuclear cells with oval to indented nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and small nucleoli; residual megakaryocytes and hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. The aspirate smear contains numerous blasts with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, some showing nuclear folding suggestive of monocytic differentiation; Auer rods are not identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with relapsed acute myeloid leukemia; morphology does not specify the genetic subtype, and the reported biallelic CEBPA mutation requires molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: NPM1-mutated AML may show cup-like (fish-mouth) nuclear invaginations and often a normal karyotype as well, so separation from CEBPA-mutated AML requires molecular testing or aberrant cytoplasmic NPM1 immunostaining.
Monocytic features overlap, but the diagnosis of a genetically defined entity rests on detecting biallelic CEBPA (bZIP) mutation rather than on nuclear folding or nonspecific esterase alone.

ddx.dx: Post-transplant regenerating marrow with left shift
ddx.vs: Regeneration shows orderly maturation with promyelocytes and myelocytes outnumbering blasts, whereas here sheets of blasts efface the marrow and blasts are numerous on the aspirate.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm/MDS with excess blasts
ddx.vs: MDS-EB has <20% blasts with prominent multilineage dysplasia, whereas the aspirate here is dominated by blasts exceeding the AML threshold.

captions: Peripheral blood: circulating blast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Peripheral blood: two mature neutrophils, one with small nuclear appendages
Peripheral blood: granulated leukocyte with folded nucleus
Core biopsy, low power: hypercellular marrow with diffuse immature infiltrate
Core biopsy, medium power: sheets of blasts with hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Core biopsy, high power: blasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Core biopsy, high power: paratrabecular blast infiltrate
Core biopsy, high power: blasts with a small hypolobated megakaryocyte
Aspirate: numerous blasts with basophilic cytoplasm
Aspirate: blasts with grey-blue cytoplasm and folded nuclei (monocytoid features)

4.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮被單一形態的中型未成熟細胞瀰漫浸潤，細胞在膠原束間穿插排列，核染色質細、可見小核仁與核分裂；在已知慢性骨髓性腫瘤病史下，免疫染色呈骨髓系顆粒狀胞質陽性，支持髓外骨髓腫瘤（leukemia cutis）。
features: Dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate extending up to a thin, largely spared zone beneath an intact epidermis
Monotonous medium-sized immature cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Tumor cells dissect between and single-file around collagen bundles
Frequent mitoses and scattered apoptotic bodies
Unlabeled IHC shows weak granular cytoplasmic/membranous positivity in tumor cells with a negative epidermis
4.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate beneath an intact epidermis, with tumor cells dissecting between collagen bundles. At high power the infiltrate consists of monotonous medium-sized immature cells with fine chromatin, small nucleoli, scant to moderate cytoplasm, frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies; no epidermotropism is identified. An immunostain (marker not labeled in the image) shows weak granular cytoplasmic positivity in the neoplastic cells while the epidermis is negative, in keeping with a myeloid immunophenotype described for this case. In the setting of a known chronic myeloid neoplasm, findings are consistent with extramedullary myeloid tumor (leukemia cutis), representing blast transformation.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are CD20/PAX5-positive and MPO/CD33/lysozyme-negative.
BPDCN shows similar blastic dermal sheets but is CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+ and MPO/lysozyme-negative.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma expresses TdT with CD3 or CD79a/PAX5 and lacks myeloid markers such as MPO.

ddx.dx: Merkel cell carcinoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Merkel cell carcinoma has salt-and-pepper chromatin with nuclear molding and is CK20 dot-like and neuroendocrine-marker positive but CD45-negative.

captions: H&E low power: diffuse dermal infiltrate beneath intact epidermis
H&E high power: medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin dissecting collagen, mitoses
IHC (unlabeled): weak granular cytoplasmic positivity in tumor cells, negative epidermis

66116.recognize_zh: 這是左眼眼底照片（視神經盤在畫面左側），在視神經盤上顳側可見一塊邊界清楚的紅色視網膜內出血，上緣帶淡白色弧形反光；白血病患者出現此類出血需考慮 Roth spot，但本圖中央白心並不明顯。
features: Color fundus photograph of the left eye with the optic disc at the left edge of the image
Single well-demarcated, oval to boat-shaped red intraretinal hemorrhage superotemporal to the optic disc along the superior arcade
Faint pale arc at the upper margin of the hemorrhage; a distinct central white core is not clearly seen
Optic disc margins appear sharp; retinal vessels are prominent without obvious sheathing
Central bright reflex near the macula is a photographic light artifact; image digitally enhanced (watermark)
66116.describe_en: Color fundus photograph of the left eye shows a single well-circumscribed intraretinal hemorrhage superotemporal to the optic disc, adjacent to the superior vascular arcade, with a faint pale rim along its upper edge. A definite central white fibrin-platelet core is not clearly resolved in this enhanced image, and no additional hemorrhages, cotton-wool spots or disc edema are evident; the central whitish patch is a light reflex artifact. The title describes chronic myeloid leukemia while the case is filed under CMML, and the ocular finding itself does not distinguish these entities. In a patient with leukemia, the hemorrhage is compatible with a Roth spot, reflecting anemia, thrombocytopenia and/or leukostasis.

ddx.vs: These show multiple dot-blot or flame hemorrhages with microaneurysms, hard exudates or arteriolar narrowing rather than an isolated white-centered hemorrhage in a cytopenic patient.
The fundus lesion is identical; separation depends on blood cultures, echocardiography and the blood count rather than ophthalmoscopic appearance.
Vein occlusion produces numerous flame hemorrhages in the drainage territory of the occluded vein with venous dilation and tortuosity, not a single focal hemorrhage.
Leukemic infiltrates appear as elevated grayish-white nodules or perivascular sheathing rather than a flat red hemorrhage.

4228.recognize_zh: 大小正常的紅血球內有兩個成熟的滋養體/早期裂殖體，胞內含深褐黑色瘧色素（hemozoin）與數個染色質點；感染的紅血球沒有變大、也沒有 Schüffner 小點，符合惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）。
features: Two parasitized red cells containing compact mature trophozoites/early schizonts with dark brown-black hemozoin pigment
Parasites show several chromatin dots and bluish cytoplasm filling part of the host cell
Infected red cells are normal in size, without Schüffner stippling
Background of densely packed, uninfected red cells; no gametocytes or white cells in field
4228.describe_en: Smear from a bone marrow aspirate preparation (thin, erythrocyte-rich area) shows two parasitized red cells containing pigmented mature trophozoites/early schizonts with coarse dark hemozoin and several chromatin dots. The infected erythrocytes are not enlarged and lack Schüffner stippling. No gametocytes are present in this field, and marrow cellular elements are not included. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum infection with mature (pigmented) asexual forms, which are typically sequestered in tissue and marrow rather than circulating.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale mature forms enlarge the host red cell and show Schüffner stippling, whereas these infected cells are normal-sized without stippling.
P. malariae shows band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts in small red cells, and species confirmation may require PCR when only pigmented trophozoites are seen.
Babesia lacks hemozoin pigment and schizonts and may form Maltese-cross tetrads.
